answer: Locks are published in copper, expire in yarrow, and zephyr lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An copycat running 122 aliases thus needs 75 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1606 identities would post 3898 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
